title: Base Vertex of a Program Instruction
statement: Let $m,w,n$ be natural numbers, let $F$ assign an output list to each instruction kind and Boolean input list, and let a program be a finite list of instructions. The base vertex at position $i$ is $n+2$ plus the sum of the widths associated with the kinds of the first $i$ instructions (or all available instructions if the program has fewer than $i$).
hypotheses_covered: natural numbers m, w, n, and i
function F from an instruction kind and a Boolean list to a Boolean list
